title: The Insane Story Behind the Bugatti Chiron
description:
The Bugatti Chiron exists because of a toy in a souvenir shop, a sketch on an envelope, and a brand that had died more than once. The company behind it lost a founder's son in a crash, went bankrupt in Italy, and was bought for its name alone. This is the insane story behind the Bugatti Chiron. It is a story with a Monaco racing driver, a Formula One champion buying a car without asking for a discount, a former Formula One driver breaking a record without a helmet, and a car that ended up being sold by a company Volkswagen no longer owns.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
